verified_facts.text: The hotel is at Potsdamer Platz in Berlin's city center, near Tiergarten and a seven-minute walk from Brandenburg Gate.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton, Berlin, at Potsdamer Platz, is a Berlin hotel in the city center just moments from Tiergarten and a seven-minute walk from Brandenburg Gate.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites combine Art Deco styled design elements with contemporary touches in homage to Berlin's Golden Age.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have dramatic floor-to-ceiling headboards that use color and geometric patterns.
